_note: ADR-048: the static obstacle (post, crossbar). The ball's trajectory meets the obstacle's geometry; the effect is a declared reflection (the normal component of the velocity is reversed, scaled by the elasticity). No die.
_source: The goal's width and height are Law 1's, read from laws.json (2026-11-23, code audit C1). Posts and crossbar have the same width, max 12 cm; prototype radius 6 cm each side. Elasticity: arbitrary, declared, prototype 0.8 (a metal post returns most of the normal velocity, a wooden one less). The two radii are prototype values until a cited source is chosen (L3).
